{{Mainspace/Character}} {{Character Infobox |color={{black color}} |corecolor={{blue color light}} |bordercolor={{yellow color dark}} |text=fff |name=Geeta |jname=オモダカ |tmname=Omodaka |image=Geeta HZ.png |size=150px |caption=Geeta |gender=Female |hair=Black |eyes=Blue and yellow |hometown=Unknown |region=[[Paldea]] }} {{Character Infobox/Anime |color={{blue color light}} |series=[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]] |debut=''[[HZ046|Welcome to Naranja Academy!]]'' |enva=Unknown |jpva=[[Sanae Kobayashi]] }} {{Character Infobox/Team |color={{blue color light}} |member=[[Paldea League]] |rank={{pkmn|Champion}} }} |} '''Geeta''' (Japanese: '''オモダカ''' ''Omodaka'') is a recurring character in the [[Pokémon anime]]. She is the {{pkmn|Champion}} of the [[Paldea]] [[region]]'s [[Paldea League|Pokémon League]]. ==In animation == === History === [[File:HZ057.png|250px|thumb|left|Geeta and Clavel being introduced to Terapagos]] Geeta debuted in ''[[HZ046|Welcome to Naranja Academy!]]'', being introduced as the chairwoman of [[Naranja Academy]]'s school board to [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and [[Dot]]. She and [[Clavell]] explained the [[Tera Training]] course to the new students and gave the three their own [[Tera Orb]]s. She later watched the battle between Liko and [[Ann]] along with the Paldea [[Elite Four]]. In ''[[HZ055|Showdown! The Paldea Elite Four]]'' and ''[[HZ056|Liko vs. Rika! Towards the Battle's End]]'', Geeta appeared watching the [[Elite Four Tag Battle]] battles. During Liko and [[Katy]]'s battle against [[Rika]], Geeta noticed [[Grusha]]'s interest in the young Trainer. In ''[[HZ057|The Terapagos I Don't Know]]'', alongside Clavell, Geeta was introduced to {{an|Terapagos}} during a meeting with [[Friede]], Liko, Roy, and Dot. After telling them what she knew about the Pokémon, Geeta talked about [[Area Zero]], and together with Clavell recommended that the group seek help from [[Raifort]] to find out more about Terapagos and [[Laqua]]. In ''[[HZ066|Infiltrating the System! Naranja Academy in Danger!]]'', Geeta was talking with Ryme and Larry during the Naranja Academy tournament. Later, she, alongside Clavell were in the staffroom with Liko and Grusha. Geeta and Clavell informed Liko that Grusha re-evaluated his thoughts and passed Liko in her implementation test due to her heroic acts of fighting against the Explorers and winning to protect the school. Geeta further complimented Liko on how her battling skills are truly worthy of using Terastallization in battle, much to Liko's surprise and joy. In ''[[HZ067|Shine on, Terastallization! Liko vs. Roy!]]'', Geeta and Rika met up with Liko to discuss the results of her training, she then watched Liko's battle against Roy. [[File:Geeta Tera Orb.png|250px|thumb|Geeta's Tera Orb]] In ''[[HZ079|Over the Top!]]'', Geeta battled against Liko, Roy, and Dot to test their strength and see if they are fit to enter Area Zero. Geeta managed to defeat Roy and Dot before losing to Liko, resulting in her loss and giving the Rising Volt Tacklers permission to enter Area Zero. Geeta reappeared in a flashback in ''[[HZ085|The Pokémon Paradise of Laqua!]]''. === Character === Geeta has a calm, kind, and polite personality, and as the head of the Paldea Pokémon League she takes her work very seriously. She is encouraging and honorable as a person such as when she encouraged Liko on her progress as a trainer, and congratulated her passing Grusha's test and saving the school. Befitting her status as the Paldea champion, Geeta is a strong and experienced trainer who loves battling against other strong trainers, and is very strategic with her attack plans against her opponents, usually staying calm and focused mid battle. === Pokémon === This listing is of Geeta's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|HZ}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Geeta |pkmn=Glimmora {{TeraIcon|Rock}} |type1=Rock |type2=Poison |img=Geeta Glimmora.png |img2=Geeta Glimmora Terastal.png |epnum=HZ079 |epname=Over the Top! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Glimmora}} is Geeta's first known Pokémon. It was used alongside two {{p|Glimmet}} in her battle against [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and [[Dot]]. It defeated Crocalor and Quaxwell before losing to Floragato, causing Geeta to lose the match. Glimmora's known moves are {{m|Dazzling Gleam}}, {{m|Spiky Shield}}, {{m|Tera Blast}} and {{m|Mortal Spin}}{{tt|*|mentioned only}}, and its [[Ability]] is {{a|Toxic Debris}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Geeta |pkmn=Glimmet (×2) |type1=Rock |type2=Poison |img=Geeta Glimmet.png |gender= |epnum=HZ079 |epname=Over the Top! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Glimmet}} are Geeta's second and third known Pokémon. They were used alongside {{p|Glimmora}} in her battle against [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and [[Dot]]. During the battle both Glimmet knocked themselves out using Memento on Crocalor and Quaxwell. Their known moves are {{m|Rock Polish}}, {{m|Power Gem}}, {{m|Venoshock}}, and {{m|Memento}}.}} ===Achievements=== ====Pokémon League==== Geeta has competed in the [[Paldea League]].
